headline: Millat Tractors will launch five lithium-ion electric bikes and scooters on November 29, made by its subsidiary Millat Industrial with an annual capacity of 250,000 units, Business Recorder reports.

card.desc: Saalana 250,000 units banane ki salahiyat, dealers muqarrar

caption:
Millat Tractors ab electric bikes aur scooters layegi! 🛵
Business Recorder ke mutabiq Pakistan ki sab se bari tractor company Millat Tractors 29 November ko electric bikes aur scooters launch karegi. Company paanch lithium-ion bikes aur scooters ke sath EV market mein aa rahi hai. Yeh bikes us ki subsidiary Millat Industrial banayegi, jis ki saalana salahiyat 250,000 units hai. Company ke mutabiq dealers muqarrar ho chuke hain aur production jari hai.
